**Finding: Compliant** (rule LD — liquidated damages payable by Customer).

No Customer-payable liquidated damages, penalties, or early-termination/minimum-exit fees exist anywhere in the Agreement:

- **§14 (Termination)** — exit is by written notice only; TrueLink continues service to the end of the following month. No fee.
- **§13 (Term)** — auto-renewal terminable on 30 days' notice before year-end, with no non-renewal charge.
- **§5 (Compensation)** — Client pays only for requested Hosting/Support Services; the blank "$___ per month" minimums are ordinary committed monthly service charges during the term, not stipulated damages on termination.
- **§7 (Unsolicited Commercial E-Mail)** — the anti-spam covenant carries no per-message or per-incident monetary charge against Client (the planner's suspected penalty is absent).

This satisfies the preferred position, so no redline was proposed. Flagged in the rationale for commercial follow-up only (not as a deviation under this rule): the §5a monthly minimums are left blank, and §6 carves those minimums out of Client's right to supporting documentation and to contest charges — worth closing under the pricing/audit rules.
